module: Flowgraph node 'Expression' (simple category, file math). Evaluates a Lua math expression (data.expression) on pins a, b, c... (number, vec3 or quat) and outputs the result on 'value'. The environment exposes the math functions, clamp, round, sign, lerp, inverseLerp, smoothstep, case, vec3, quat, quatFromEuler, terrainHeight, pingpong, random, etc. Pin tables are converted to vec3 (3 components) or quat (4). Offered templates: distance between two positions, lerp.
usage: Expression: '(a-b):length()' with a and b of type vec3 gives the distance; 'lerp(a,b,c)' interpolates.
notes: A pin table is interpreted as a quat if it has 4 elements, otherwise as a vec3.
No character whitelist is applied: any function exposed in the environment (and the vec3/quat methods) can be called.
The keyworkdWhiteListLookup table is built but never used.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawCustomProperties.desc: List of expression templates and description of their pins.

buildBaseEnv.desc: Builds the expression environment (math functions and utilities, pin reading with vec3/quat cache).

parseExpression.desc: Rejects assignments (isolated '=') then compiles 'return <expression>' with load() in the environment.

work.desc: In safeMode, does nothing if a connected input is nil. Recompiles if the expression changed, runs with pcall, converts a vec3/quat result (cdata) to a table {x,y,z[,w]}, writes 'value' and reports errors (node + logEvent).

onLink.desc: Creates an additional input pin (next letter, default value 0) when a link is added and a pin is missing.

init.desc: safeMode=true, empty expression, creation of the environment and the vec3/quat caches.
